model: step-5-preview (StepFun Step Plan, OpenAI-compatible chat completions)
notes: Parity on the 12-bug parity split (first Lite bug of each of the 11 systems plus kafka-13668; 10% of the 120-bug benchmark). 3 runs per side. Protocol on both sides: one attempt per bug per run; a missing or schema-invalid diagnosis would score 0 (none occurred). Both sides rescored offline with the same upstream distdebug_bench.score.score_run (scripts/parity_compare.py); Harbor's in-container reward.json matched the upstream rescoring on 36/36 trials. Upstream leakage check: 0 of 36 traces flagged on each side. One earlier Harbor trial (run 2, elasticsearch-128583) was flagged because Harbor's mini-swe-agent wrote the trial name (bug id) into an agent-readable log; it was excluded and rerun with session_id_headers: [] (now set in the parity config; see README). All seven upstream metrics overlap (function_coverage, line_coverage, strict_block_coverage, block_precision, mention_coverage are in the README). Prompts verified byte-identical on real trajectories except mini-swe-agent's <system_information> uname line (original: x86_64 Linux host with bubblewrap; Harbor: aarch64 Linux VM via Colima). Values are percentages (mean over 12 bugs), mean ± sample SEM over runs. Parity artifacts: harborframework/parity-experiments is over the Hub's 1M-file limit, so the files are mirrored at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Nhckdvrl/distdebug-bench-parity-experiments until PR 294 can accept them.
